description: .NET version upgrade plan from net6.0 to net10.0 LTS

tasks.description: Upgrade ContosoUniversity from net6.0 to net10.0 and update 4 NuGet packages
tasks.reason: The project targets net6.0 which is out of support. Upgrading to net10.0 LTS ensures continued security patches, performance improvements, and long-term support. The 4 referenced NuGet packages (EF Core, ASP.NET Core diagnostics, and scaffolding) must also be updated to versions compatible with net10.0.
tasks.requirements: 1. In ContosoUniversity\ContosoUniversity.csproj, change <TargetFramework>net6.0</TargetFramework> to <TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>. 2. Update package references: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Diagnostics.EntityFrameworkCore from 6.0.2 to 10.0.5, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer from 6.0.2 to 10.0.5, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Tools from 6.0.2 to 10.0.5, Microsoft.VisualStudio.Web.CodeGeneration.Design from 6.0.2 to 10.0.2. 3. Run dotnet restore. 4. Build solution and fix all compilation errors. 5. Review Program.cs line 17 (app.UseExceptionHandler("/Error")) for behavioral change in .NET 10 — verify the /Error route exists and behavior is correct. 6. Run dotnet test if tests exist. Verify solution builds with 0 errors.
tasks.taskSummary: Successfully upgraded ContosoUniversity from net6.0 to net10.0. Updated TargetFramework and 4 NuGet packages (Microsoft.AspNetCore.Diagnostics.EntityFrameworkCore 6.0.2→10.0.5, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer 6.0.2→10.0.5, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Tools 6.0.2→10.0.5, Microsoft.VisualStudio.Web.CodeGeneration.Design 6.0.2→10.0.2). dotnet restore and dotnet build both pass with 0 errors and 0 warnings. UseExceptionHandler /Error route verified to exist (Pages/Error.cshtml). No test projects found.
